获取分群列表
```
curl -X POST "http://{host}:{port}/api/v3/horizon/v1/segment/definition/list" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "sensorsdata-project: {projectName}" \
  -H "api-key: {apiKey}" \
  -d '{"entity_name":"user","segment_definition_names":["user_segment_t","user_segment_c001"],"segment_definition_fuzzy_name":"segment_c","create_time_range":{"start_time":"2025-04-01T00:00:00Z","end_time":"2025-04-30T23:59:59Z"},"has_valid_segment":true,"show_inv

获取分群信息
```
curl -X POST "http://{host}:{port}/api/v3/horizon/v1/segment/definition/get" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "sensorsdata-project: {projectName}" \
  -H "api-key: {apiKey}" \
  -d '{"entity_name":"user","name":"user_segment_t"}'

删除分群
```
curl -X POST "http://{host}:{port}/api/v3/horizon/v1/segment/definition/delete" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "sensorsdata-project: {projectName}" \
  -H "api-key: {apiKey}" \
  -d '{ "entity_name": "user",
        "name": "user_segment_wdfq1"

更新例行分群的调度状态
```
curl -X POST "http://{host}:{port}/api/v3/horizon/v1/segment/definition/status/update" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "sensorsdata-project: {projectName}" \
  -H "api-key: {apiKey}" \
  -d '{"entity_name":"user","name":"user_segment_wdfq1","status":"SUSPENDED"}'
```

触发分群计算
```
curl -X POST 'http://{host}:{port}/api/v3/horizon/v1/segment/definition/evaluate' \
-H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "sensorsdata-project: {projectName}" \
  -H "api-key: {apiKey}" \
  -d '{
    "entity_name": "user",
    "evaluate_params": [{
        "segment_definition_name": "user_segment_t",
        "base_time": "2025-04-27T16:00:00Z"
    }]
}'
```

items.docs:
获取计算出来的分群包信息列表
```
curl -X POST "http://{host}:{port}/api/v3/horizon/v1/segment/item/list" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "sensorsdata-project: {projectName}" \
  -H "api-key: {apiKey}" \
  -d '{"entity_name":"user","definition_name":"user_segment_t","limit":5,"segment_ready":true}'
 返回值示例：
{"code":"SUCCESS","request_id":"301030287ccb2a91d6c7fefa78065f25","data":{"items":[{"base_time":"2025-04-22T16:00:00Z","segment_name":"user_user_segment_t_42_

  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "sensorsdata-project: {projectName}" \
  -H "api-key: {apiKey}" \
  -d '{"entity_name":"user","definition_names":["user_segment_t","user_segment_wdfq1"],"segment_ready":true}'
 返回值示例：

停止分群任务
```
curl -X POST "http://{host}:{port}/api/v3/horizon/v1/segment/task/cancel" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "sensorsdata-project: {projectName}" \
  -H "api-key: {apiKey}" \
  -d '{"task_ids":[4121],"sync":"false","sync_timeout_seconds":30}'
```
